limitations: Manual review of bounded synthetic API conversations, not general user accuracy, browser automation, or a load test.
remaining_issues: Natural completion reports can repeat catalog guidance, including compound Done replies.
Retaking a completed course can return course-list navigation instead of clarifying course type and selecting the relevant enrollment guidance.
Negated CAC/PIN guesses can require extra clarification despite an explicit account-lockout correction.
findings_that_held: Moodle course mapping, app/browser clarification and method switching.
Instructor versus AO copying grants; shared learner guidance for staff roles.
deployed_corrections: Persistent account-lockout context and automatic versus manual unlock wording.
CAC association goal retention and recovery completion/resume.
Own non-PME enrollment corrections, request-form progress and opening/submission boundary.
Typed PME codes exclude general non-PME enrollment guidance.
protocol_notes: Initial unpaced attempts recorded 13 HTTP 429 replies; only the synthetic client gained pacing.
A lockout replay exceeded its eight-turn cap after a duplicate call; the nine-turn transcript and an auxiliary capped run are retained.
transcripts_location: Private generated HTML report and synthetic transcripts outside the repository; session credentials excluded from the report.
